prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
# Services to Check AI Recommendations

Here are the most practical options:

## Direct Testing (Free)
- **Ask ChatGPT directly** in relevant categories ("best [your service type] in [your area]")
- Try different prompts and variations
- Check if you appear in responses

## Monitoring Tools
- **Google Search Console** - shows what queries lead to your site
- **Semrush/Ahrefs** - track mentions and visibility
- **Brand24** - monitors online mentions across platforms

## AI-Specific Monitoring
- **Perplexity AI** - test how it recommends businesses
- **Claude** - similar testing approach
- **Bing Chat** - another AI to check

## Reality Check
**Important caveat:** Most AI engines don't have real-time business databases and may:
- Recommend based on training data (which is outdated)
- Prioritize larger, well-known businesses
- Not have your business in their training data at all

## Better Strategy
Rather than chasing AI recommendations, focus on:
- **Google Business Profile** optimization (most reliable)
- **Review sites** (Yelp, Google, industry-specific)
- **Local SEO** fundamentals
- **Your own website** quality

What type of business are you running? That might help me suggest more targeted approaches.
